verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native portfolio dashboard or progress rollup. The closest support is indirect: an AI agent connected through ClickUp's MCP server can generate portfolio summaries from tasks and docs, and views can be created at any level of the hierarchy, which implies cross-project views. A third-party analytics integration also offers automated reports. Missing for 10: documented native portfolio/dashboard view, automatic progress rollup across projects (e.g., percent complete, status aggregation), first-party docs on cross-project reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
